info.title: nnke
info.description: CLI tool for Ananke — scaffold workflow projects, validate manifests, export diagrams, browse documentation, and serve as an MCP server for AI agents.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Ananke CLI — scaffold workflows, validate manifests, and export diagrams. For federation ops, install nnke-platform.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --json
options.description: Emit machine-readable JSON output instead of human-formatted text. [default: False]

commands.name: new
commands.description: Scaffold new Ananke projects and files.

commands.name: workflow
commands.description: Scaffold a complete Ananke workflow project.

options.name: --provider
options.description: LLM provider to configure (openai, anthropic, google). [default: openai]

options.name: --pattern
options.description: Workflow pattern. Run 'nnke patterns' for the full catalog. [default: etl]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory. Defaults to ./<name>.

commands.name: manifest
commands.description: Generate a standalone .ananke.yml manifest file.

options.name: --provider
options.description: LLM provider to configure (openai, anthropic, google). [default: openai]

options.name: --pattern
options.description: Workflow topology pattern (etl, fan-out, sequential). [default: etl]

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory. Defaults to current directory.

commands.name: validate
commands.description: Parse and validate an .ananke.yml manifest.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run an .ananke.yml workflow locally (stub execution — topology trace, no LLM calls).

options.name: --input
options.description: Initial input string threaded as workflow state.

options.name: --input-file
options.description: Path to a file whose contents are used as the initial input string.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Deployment profile to resolve tool bindings from (default: local). [default: local]

commands.name: serve
commands.description: Run an .ananke.yml workflow as a local HTTP server on localhost (stub execution).

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port to listen on (default: 5000). [default: 5000]

options.name: --profile
options.description: Deployment profile to resolve tool bindings from (default: local). [default: local]

commands.name: diagram
commands.description: Export a Mermaid flowchart from an .ananke.yml manifest.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output file for the Mermaid diagram. Defaults to stdout.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Analyze an Ananke project directory and produce a health report.

arguments.name: DIRECTORY
arguments.description: Project directory to inspect. Defaults to the current directory.

commands.name: explain
commands.description: Show a detailed explanation of a diagnostic error code.

arguments.name: CODE
arguments.description: Diagnostic code to explain (e.g. ANANKE_TOPO_003), or omit to list all codes.

commands.name: patterns
commands.description: List and describe recognized workflow and agentic patterns.

arguments.name: PATTERN
arguments.description: Pattern to describe (e.g. 'review-critique', 'etl'). Omit to list all.

commands.name: docs
commands.description: Browse, read, and search Ananke framework documentation.

options.name: --list
options.description: List all available documentation topics. [default: False]

options.name: --search
options.description: Search across all documentation for the given terms.

commands.name: mcp-server
commands.description: Launch nnke as an MCP server (stdio). Exposes all commands as tools for Claude, Copilot, Cursor, etc.

commands.name: mesh
commands.description: Inspect organic mesh state — cells, lineage, memory, and signals. For federation ops, use nnke-platform.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show alive cells, domains, tools, models, and routing from a host snapshot.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to a host snapshot YAML file.

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Show signal history and manifest details for a specific colony cell.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to a host snapshot YAML file.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Browse entries from an exported empirical memory file.

options.name: --cell
options.description: Filter entries by cell/entity name.

options.name: --kind
options.description: Filter by knowledge kind: pattern, skill, or heuristic.

options.name: --top
options.description: Maximum number of entries to display (default: 20). [default: 20]

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to an exported empirical memory JSON file.

commands.name: lineage
commands.description: Show ancestor/descendant tree for a cell. Reads from a host snapshot or lineage JSON export.

arguments.name: CELL
arguments.description: Cell name to show lineage for.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to a host snapshot YAML file or lineage store JSON export.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Emit a JSON schema of all nnke commands, arguments, and options.

commands.name: kernel
commands.description: Inspect organic workflow kernels — view active cells, domains, tools, and division history.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show active cells, domains, tools, and routing from a kernel snapshot.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to a kernel snapshot YAML file.

commands.name: history
commands.description: Show division history and lineage from a kernel snapshot.

arguments.name: FILE
arguments.description: Path to a kernel snapshot YAML file.
